pruning_notes.en: Pollard at start of dry season; can re-pollard mid-year Monitor canopy health and light penetration to layers below. Remove deadwood and competing growth as needed for system vigor.
pruning_notes.es: Pollard at start of dry season; can re-pollard mid-year Monitorear la salud del dosel y la penetración de luz a las capas inferiores. Eliminar madera muerta y crecimiento competidor según sea necesario para el vigor del sistema.

pruning_notes.en: Pollard 1-2x per year, into the dry season After harvest; thin to keep light in the canopy Monitor canopy health and light penetration to layers below. Remove deadwood and competing growth as needed for system vigor.
pruning_notes.es: Pollard 1-2x per year, into the dry season After harvest; thin to keep light in the canopy Monitorear la salud del dosel y la penetración de luz a las capas inferiores. Eliminar madera muerta y crecimiento competidor según sea necesario para el vigor del sistema.

pruning_notes.en: After harvest; stump/renew on a multi-year cycle Monitor canopy health and light penetration to layers below. Remove deadwood and competing growth as needed for system vigor.
pruning_notes.es: After harvest; stump/renew on a multi-year cycle Monitorear la salud del dosel y la penetración de luz a las capas inferiores. Eliminar madera muerta y crecimiento competidor según sea necesario para el vigor del sistema.

pruning_notes.en: The low layer consists of annuals, root crops, and replacement plants. Manage for continuous succession and harvest rather than annual pruning.
pruning_notes.es: La capa low consta de plantas anuales, tubérculos y plantas de reemplazo. Manejar para sucesión continua y cosecha en lugar de poda anual.
